newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds close quiet, mixed.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds close quiet, mixed.

text.p: Swiss bond trade ended a quiet day narrowly mixed as the curve flattened, with longer maturities gaining in price while EuroSwiss slipped slightly.
"It is very very quiet. We are still bullish," said one trader. The Swiss market recently had set successive new highs, pushing long-dated yields to lows unseen since the late 1970s.

One trader described Monday's activity as "a little consolidation." Demand was judged moderate for latest issues of Swiss and foreign borrowers, given that yields for 10-year paper have lately slid below 4.00 percent.
No new straights were launched on Monday.
